name: ai-control-tower
description: Read-only access to the AI Control Tower: risk register, agent registry and AI budget, plus the what-if on cutting AI credits and two TabPFN forecasts for Controlling (budget overrun per cost group, accrual estimate). Uses the bundled sample data, or your Supabase project when configured.

tools.name: get_risks
tools.description: List open AI governance risks, optionally filtered by severity, progress or owner.

tools.name: get_agent_overview
tools.description: Summary of the AI agent registry.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List agents (e.g. everything in production) with summary and filters.

tools.name: get_unregistered_assets
tools.description: Unregistered AI assets found by the discovery scan.

tools.name: get_budget
tools.description: Monthly AI budget by team group with reconciliation.

tools.name: simulate_credit_cut
tools.description: What-if: what happens if the AI credits are cut by a given percentage? Returns the new overall ceiling and headroom, each team's new utilisation, how many agent runs per day and which processes (agent families) would have to be throttled, which risks rise, and the break-even cut at which the ceiling is reached. Read-only; the model is a transparent rule set over sample data (see assumptions in the result), not a forecast. Use it for questions such as "Was passiert, wenn wir die AI-Credits um 30 % kürzen?".

tools.name: forecast_budget
tools.description: Forecast the month-end spend of each cost group against its monthly AI budget. Returns, per group, the spend so far, the expected month-end spend with an 80 % band (10th to 90th percentile), the probability of ending above budget and a status (on track, at risk, likely over), plus the model engine (TabPFN or a fallback baseline). Based on the spend so far this month and the last six months; trained on synthetic data, so it shows the method and is not a binding forecast. Use it for questions such as "Welche Teams überschreiten ihr AI-Budget diesen Monat?". Read-only.

tools.name: estimate_accruals
tools.description: Estimate the proposed month-end accruals of the Finance Pre-Close sample (fictional group "Nordlicht"): for each proposal an interval (10th to 90th percentile) for the amount the supplier invoice will probably show, and the probability that the final amount differs by more than 10 % so the accrual has to be corrected. Highest correction risk first. Returns the model engine (TabPFN or a fallback baseline). Trained on synthetic data, so it shows the method and is not an audit statement. Use it for questions such as "Welche Rückstellungen muss ich wahrscheinlich korrigieren?". Read-only.

supabase_url.title: Supabase project URL
supabase_url.description: Optional. Example: https://<project-ref>.supabase.co. Leave empty to use the bundled sample data.

supabase_secret_key.title: Supabase secret key
supabase_secret_key.description: Optional. Server-side secret key (sb_secret_…) of that project. Stored as a secret, never written to config files.

tabpfn_service_url.title: Forecast service
tabpfn_service_url.description: Optional. Address of services/tabpfn, for example http://127.0.0.1:8808 (https for anything not on this computer). Needed for forecast_budget and estimate_accruals.

tabpfn_service_token.title: Forecast service token
tabpfn_service_token.description: Optional. Bearer token if the service was started with TABPFN_SERVICE_TOKEN. Stored as a secret.
